exposure: Maternal clinical and demographic variables from the British Columbia Perinatal Data Registry (BCPDR)
Newborn clinical and demographic variables from the British Columbia Perinatal Data Registry (BCPDR)
cohort: The study participants were medical charts representing 1,084 mothers and 1,142 newborns from British Columbia, with oversampling of those with longer hospital stays or facility transfers.
finding: Many important clinical and population health variables within the British Columbia Perinatal Data Registry (BCPDR) demonstrated excellent validity and completeness.
mod_finding: Variables related to mode of birth, specifically "induction of labour" and "primary elective cesarean delivery", showed high validity in the registry.
